products.name: Unbabel
products.note: AI-human translation; quality estimation; enterprise localization; EU vendor

profile_text.body:
Unbabel is a technology company that offers what it describes as a Language Operations Platform, designed to help businesses communicate across languages and geographies. The platform combines AI-driven translation with optional human review, allowing organizations to adjust the level of human involvement depending on their quality requirements.

A notable feature of the platform is Unbabel's Quality Estimation technology, which the company describes as award-winning. This tool gives users visibility into translation performance, helps identify areas for optimization, and can be used to evaluate output from third-party translation providers as well as Unbabel's own models.

The site's held facts classify Unbabel's core product under search, research, translation, and related categories, and note its role as an enterprise localization provider and EU vendor. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
